headline: The studio's gates now distinguish unavailable evidence, prove project scope, and ratchet their own bottlenecks.

items.title: Project-scoped supply-chain truth
items.insight: The wrapper no longer spends a minute scanning the portfolio or discards nested canonical findings. Scope, parser shape, and unavailable output now fail closed together.

items.title: Unavailable evidence cannot earn green
items.insight: Doctor parse failures and RUM coverage gaps now occupy an explicit unavailable state. That small semantic distinction removes an entire family of reassuring but unsupported status claims.

items.title: One revenue freshness authority
items.insight: Startup and Doctor now consume the same source priority, clock, thresholds, and provenance. The live six-day signal can no longer be fresh in one surface and stale in another.

items.title: Five-state RUM canary
items.insight: The canary separates empty, thin, stale, anomaly, and healthy evidence while retaining last-known comparisons as context only. Today's 24-day telemetry gap reads unavailable, exactly as it should.

items.title: Fail-closed closeout rotation
items.insight: Task-board maintenance moved from agent memory into closeout ceremony. Both normalization and verbatim archive rotation are visible, idempotent, and boundary-tested.

items.title: Agent discovery derivation proof
items.insight: The agent manifest now proves filtering, routing, canonical discovery, and safe feed URLs in isolation before checking generated bytes. AI-facing trust is tested as behavior, not just file presence.

items.title: Status proof derivation proof
items.insight: Deterministic injected fixtures prove fresh, stale, missing, and honest-dark arithmetic. Trust score now has an isolated executable specification.

items.title: Build-step concentration ratchet
items.insight: A successful build cannot hide one accidental portfolio-scale step behind a green total. The duration-qualified ratio catches material dominance without freezing the suite to a brittle wall-clock budget.

followUps: Drain the Ark reply for canonical skill-trace/session-floor cache contracts.
Let genuine fresh RUM coverage advance the canary only after authorized production recovery.
blockers: Production auth/security promotion remains explicitly held.
RUM ingest remains externally stale until legitimate Worker recovery.

honestyLedger.title: Two generated test ideas rejected
honestyLedger.why: Live callers already ran those self-tests; duplicate smoke tests would be phantom throughput.

honestyLedger.title: No RUM green manufactured
honestyLedger.why: Twenty-four-day-old, insufficient route evidence cannot answer the current-health question.

honestyLedger.title: No production promotion
honestyLedger.why: The existing auth/security hold remains binding and was not broadened by the arc directive.
